Let me look at what your squat has actually been doing. Nothing is logged for your squat yet, and I don't see an active program, so I can't point to the exact spot where it stalled. Here is what usually works.

First, check the basics: are you sleeping and eating enough, and is the bar speed the same on your last rep as it was weeks ago? A plateau is often just fatigue sitting on top of fitness.

Second, change the rep range for a few weeks. If you have been grinding heavy triples, try sets of 5 to 8 with a weight that leaves 2 or 3 reps in the tank. If you have been living at higher reps, go heavier and lower.

Third, add a variation that hits your weak point, such as pause squats if you get stuck out of the hole, or front squats if your chest drops. Keep the sets crisp, with full rest between them.

If it hasn't moved in many weeks, a lighter deload week can also reset things.

Tell me roughly what you have been squatting (weight, sets, reps) and how many days a week, and I can be more specific. I can also build you a block with squat as the focus if you'd like.
